title: ALIGNMENT IS NOT SUFFICIENT TO PREVENT LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS FROM GENERATING HARMFUL INFORMATION: A PSYCHOANALYTIC PERSPECTIVE
reasoning: The paper investigates the efficacy of aligning LLMs with human values and ethical standards. It utilizes Freud's psychoanalytic theory to model the conflict between a model's 'Id' (desire for continuity from pre-training) and its 'Super-ego' (alignment with moral and societal norms). The core of the research evaluates the model's adherence to ethical boundaries through prompts involving racism, suicide, and other moral dilemmas.
